lesson.title: Language review 5
lesson.title_ar: مراجعة القواعد 5: المضارع التام المستمر مقابل البسيط، والأفعال المتبوعة بـ to / -ing

lines: 1 talk about the present effects of something that happened over a period of time in the recent past.
2 talk about a continuous action that started in the past, continued up to now and may be continuing now.
3 show that something has been changing or developing over a period of time and has been happening regularly.

Examples: He has been playing football. (That's why his clothes are dirty.) | It has been raining. (That's why the clothes are wet.) | Mona has been studying English for six years. (And she is still studying English.) | The weather has been getting warmer recently.
Compare the Present perfect simple and the Present perfect continuous tenses.
The simple tense: • emphasizes the completion of the action • can refer to actions that happened a long time ago | Examples: I've done my homework. I've read that book.

The continuous tense: • emphasizes how long the action has been going on • usually refers to something that has been happening recently | Examples: I've been doing my homework for hours. I've been reading that book. (just now)
• Both tenses can be used to describe actions that started in the past and are still continuing.
Examples: I have lived here for six years. (Perhaps the speaker will not continue living there.) | I have been living here since 1994. (The speaker will probably go on living here.)
• The following verbs are not used with the continuous tense: be, have (= own), believe, know, need, like, love, prefer

interactive_spot.label: التمييز الدقيق بين المضارع التام البسيط والمستمر والأفعال الجامدة

simple_explain.html:
• استعمل has/have been + V-ing عندما: ترى أثراً حاضراً (my eyes hurt / That's why I'm tired)، أو استغراقاً مستمراً (for three hours now / for long enough)، أو تدرّجاً (getting better marks in the last two months).
  • استعمل has/have + V3 عندما: يكون الفعل مكتملاً أو معدوداً (twice, many countries, never)، أو منفياً عن كامل المدة (hasn't rained for the last five years)، أو مع أفعال لا تقبل الاستمرار (be, have (own), believe, know, need, like, love, prefer).

example.html:
We have known him for a long time. (know = non-continuous)
He has been listening for long enough now. (continuous action)

lines: The verbs may be followed either by the infinitive or the -ing form:
begin, continue, start, like, love, prefer, hate
Examples: It began to rain / began raining. I (don't) like to sail / like sailing.
Note: When would is used in front of like, love, prefer, hate, you must use to + infinitive.
Now do activities A, B, and C in the Workbook.

blocks.edu_note_html: تنبيه مهم لتمرين WB 3.5 C #2: طُبع في WB p. 33 الخيار start work/to work (حيث work اسم وليس working؛ وكلاهما صحيح لغوياً مع start)، وحُفظت الصيغة المطبوعة حرفياً مع شرحها.

simple_explain.html:
• الأفعال السبعة (begin, continue, start, like, love, prefer, hate) تقبل عادةً الصورتين: to + V1 أو V-ing.
  • الاستثناء الحاسم في الاختبارات: متى سُبقت like / love / prefer / hate بالفعل would وجب حصراً استعمال to + infinitive (مثل Would you like to stay / would hate to be / would prefer to live).

example.html:
I hate to work / working (both OK).
I would hate to be in his shoes. (ONLY to + infinitive)

activities.prompt_literal: 3.5 A Read these sentences and underline the more suitable form of the verb.
activities.prompt_ar: اختر صيغة الفعل الأدق لكل جملة (1 في ص 32، و2–6 في ص 33):

items.prompt: 1 She [has never visited / has never been visiting] India in her life: ______
2 Why haven't you tidied your room? — I [have done / have been doing] my homework: ______
3 We [have known / have been knowing] him for a long time: ______
4 Why [haven't they arrived / haven't they been arriving]? — ______
5 I [have gone / have been going] out a lot recently. That's why I'm tired: ______
6 We [have walked / have been walking] for three hours now. Can we stop for a rest? — ______

hints: 1: تجربة حياة عامة (بسيط). 2: سبب عدم الترتيب لانشغاله المتواصل (مستمر). 3: know جامد لا يقبل الاستمرار. 4: arrived لحظي مكتمل. 5 و6: أثر حاضر ومدة متواصلة (مستمر).

activities.prompt_literal: B Write the verbs in brackets in the more suitable form of the Present perfect.
activities.prompt_ar: اكتب الفعل بالصيغة المناسبة من المضارع التام البسيط أو المستمر (انتبه لنفي المطر في الجملة 2 بسبب الجفاف!):

items.prompt: 1 Well done, Fareeda! You (to get) ______ much better marks in the last two months.
2 The drought is terrible. It (to rain) ______ for the last five years.
3 I (to be; never) ______ to Great Britain. I hope to go one day.
4 In his life my father (to visit) ______ many different countries. He often tells us about them.
5 The manager (to listen) ______ to your new song twice and, to be honest, he doesn't like it.
6 Tell Faisal to come and help. He (to listen) ______ to his cassettes for long enough now.
7 I (to know) ______ my best friend for almost fourteen years.
8 I (to work) ______ at the computer for ten hours non-stop. It's no wonder my eyes hurt.

hints: 1: تغير متطور (مستمر). 2: drought يعني انقطاع المطر ← نفي بسيط hasn't rained! 3 و7: be وknow لا تقبل الاستمرار. 4 و5: مرات مكتملة (twice / in his life). 6 و8: استمرار متواصل وأثر راهن.

activities.prompt_literal: C In the sentence below, cross out the incorrect forms of the verbs. Note that in some sentences both forms are correct.
activities.prompt_ar: حدّد أي الصيغ صحيحة وأيها يُشطب في الجمل 1–4 وفق قاعدة 2 في PB ص 20 (انتبه لحالات صحة الصيغتين معاً!):

items.question: Would you like staying/to stay at home or would you prefer going/to go for a walk along the corniche?
items.model_answer: Keep 'to stay' and 'to go' (cross out 'staying' and 'going').
items.explain_ar: لوجود would قبل like وprefer يلزم استعمال to + infinitive في الموضعين.

items.question: I hate to work/working in the evenings so I start work/to work very early in the morning.
items.model_answer: Both forms are correct in both halves! ('to work' & 'working' after 'hate'; and 'work' [noun] & 'to work' [infinitive] after 'start').
items.explain_ar: لا يوجد would أمام hate فتصح الصيغتان؛ وفي القسم الثاني جاء في المطبوعة start work (اسم) وto work وكلاهما سليم (وربما كانت المقصودة أصلاً working/to work).

items.question: I would hate being/to be in his shoes when his father starts to look/looking at his homework.
items.model_answer: First choice: keep 'to be' only (cross out 'being'). Second choice: BOTH 'to look' and 'looking' are correct.
items.explain_ar: would hate تلزم to be؛ أما starts بدون would فتقبل الصيغتين.

items.question: Ali's father continues to live/living in the town although the rest of the family would prefer living/to live in the country.
items.model_answer: First choice: BOTH 'to live' and 'living' are correct. Second choice: keep 'to live' only (cross out 'living').
items.explain_ar: continues تقبل الصيغتين؛ أما would prefer فتلزم to live.

hints: القاعدة الذهبية: أينما ظهر كلمة would قبل like/love/prefer/hate، اشطب -ing وأبقِ to + verb.

questions.stem: According to PB page 20, which verb is NOT normally used in the Present perfect continuous tense?

options.text: know (e.g., We have known him for a long time)
study (e.g., Mona has been studying English)
options.why_wrong: الفعل study يدل على نشاط مستمر، وقد مثل الكتاب به في PB ص 20: Mona has been studying English.

options.text: work (e.g., working at the computer for ten hours)
options.why_wrong: الفعل work من الأفعال المستمرة الشائعة في المضارع التام المستمر.
أورد الكتاب هذا المثال حرفياً في صندوق أمثلة المضارع التام المستمر.

hints: اقرأ قائمة الأفعال المستثناة في PB ص 20 قبل قسم 2.
القائمة: be, have (=own), believe, know, need, like, love, prefer.
questions.explain: الفعل know من أفعال الحالة والإدراك التي ينص PB ص 20 على عدم استعمالها في صيغة الاستمرار.

questions.stem: Which option correctly completes: 'Although my father continues ______ in town, I would prefer ______ in the country' (PB p. 20)?

options.text: living / to live ... to live (only 'to live' after 'would prefer')

options.why_wrong: بعد would prefer يجب استعمال to + infinitive دائماً وفق ملاحظة PB ص 20.
يتبع to مصدر مجرد (to live) لا V-ing.
الأفعال continue وprefer لا تُتبع بمصدر عارٍ دون to.

hints: انتبه لوجود would في الطرف الثاني (would prefer).
الصحيح: تصح الصيغتان بعد continues، وتتعين to live بعد would prefer.
questions.explain: تقبل continue كلاً من to + V1 وV-ing، أما would prefer فتشترط to + infinitive.

flashcards.back: be, have (=own), believe, know, need, like, love, prefer
